title: Enforce the two-round review limit in the engine and preflight
body:
ADR 0014 D10 allows at most two review rounds, but src/flow/prior.ts only refuses a prior record that is itself round two; a round-one FAIL can seed any number of later round-two runs and a fresh round one is always accepted, and scripts/pr-preflight.mjs only checks the exact-head record.
Acceptance: the engine and preflight count review rounds per PR and base and refuse a third unless an explicit operator exception is recorded on the record; RED on base, GREEN on head.
